title: 第11章 天阶极品至宝 惊天游龙剑第12章 青帝在等人是谁竟然有如此殊荣
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
“哈哈哈哈，不愧是朕的孩子。诸位，你们也听到了，朕的小十一说了，你们，不配！”
青帝冷笑着看着四大宗门和两大书院开口。
话音落下，四大宗门和两大书院之人一个个尽皆极具愤怒的瞪了陆尘一眼，随后语气生硬的开口。
“陛下，既然十一殿下看不起我等，我等也不在这里丢人现眼了，老朽告退！”
“告辞！”
宗门书院之人也不等青帝说话。一个个气冲冲的甩袖离去。
看着六人的背影，青帝脸上露出了冰冷的神色和一丝杀意！
有好处了，一个个上来五体投地的祈求。
捞不上好处了，一个个当着青帝的面甩脸子，身为大乾国土之宗门，却没有任何恭敬之心！
如此不要脸之徒。青帝也是忍了很久了。
“小十一，你怎么看这四大宗门和两大书院！”
青帝背对着陆尘悠悠开口。
“父皇，四大宗门和两大书院实乃我大乾之寄生虫，寄生虫不除，我大乾难兴！”
陆尘毫不犹豫的开口。
“是啊。嗯……”
听到此言，青帝下意识的点头，但是反应过来，青帝却是脸色微变，猛的转身看向六岁稚嫩的陆尘。
此刻，青帝内心波涛汹涌。
这话要是要是其它皇子说出来，比如说大皇子二皇子，青帝会淡定的夸奖上一句。
但是这话是陆尘说出来……
要知道陆尘才只有六岁啊！

六岁啊！
六岁的时候还在撒尿和泥巴呢。
结果陆尘竟然一针见血的说出了大乾的弊病！
这是国事！
陆尘这一句话给青帝带来的震撼，不比陆尘的天赋要带来的天赋小。
而陆尘看到青帝震撼的神色。
也立马反应过来。
淦！
忘了球了！
自己现在才六岁？
说出刚才的话，实在是骇人听闻了。
“嘿嘿嘿，父皇，刚才那话是大哥说的！”
content_en:
"Hahahaha, you are worthy of being my child. Everyone, you have also heard that my little Eleven said that you are not worthy!"
Qingdi sneered and looked at the four major sects and the two major academies.
After the words fell, people from the four major sects and the two major academies all glared at Lu Chen angrily, and then spoke in a stiff tone.
"Your Majesty, since His Highness Eleven looks down on us, we don't want to be embarrassed here anymore. I'll take my leave!"
"Farewell!"
The people in Zongmen Academy did not wait for Emperor Qing to speak. One by one, they threw away their sleeves angrily.
Looking at the backs of the six people, Emperor Qing showed a cold look and a trace of murderous intent on his face!
It's good, everyone came up and prayed.
There is no benefit to be gained. They are scorning each other in front of the Qing Emperor. As a sect of the Daqian Kingdom, they have no respect at all!
Such a shameless person. Qingdi also endured it for a long time.
"Xiao Shiyi, what do you think of these four major sects and two major academies!"
Qingdi turned his back to Lu Chen and spoke leisurely.
"Father, the four major sects and the two major academies are really parasites on my great cadre. If the parasites are not eliminated, it will be difficult for my great cadre to prosper!"
Lu Chen spoke without hesitation.
"Yeah. Well..."
Hearing this, Qingdi nodded subconsciously, but when he reacted, Qingdi's face changed slightly and he turned around to look at the immature six-year-old Lu Chen.
At this moment, Emperor Qing's heart was filled with turmoil.
If other princes said this, such as the eldest prince and the second prince, Qing Emperor would calmly praise him.
But it was Lu Chen who said this...
You know Lu Chen is only six years old!
Six years old!
At six years old, he was still peeing and muddy.
As a result, Lu Chen actually pointed out the shortcomings of Daqian!
This is a state matter!
The shock that Lu Chen's words brought to Qingdi was no less than the talent that Lu Chen's talent would bring.
Lu Chen saw Qingdi's shocked expression.
He also reacted immediately.
Gan!
Forgot the ball!
Are you only six years old now?
What he said just now is really shocking.
"Hehehe, Father, it was my elder brother who said that just now!"
